hypothesis: A compiled Beast capability improves matched task correctness or efficiency without increasing unsupported claims.

conditions.description: Transcript-only control: the agent receives the source task, transcript, and normal tools, but no video frames or compiled Beast Pack.
Watching control: the same envelope receives the transcript and initial adaptive sparse frames, but no uncertainty-driven reinspection or compiled Beast Pack.

SkillsBench comparator: same envelope receives a human/agent-curated skill written from the same tutorial without Beast machinery (no evidence map, typed contract, or lifecycle); curator is not the compiler builder and is time-capped at the median C3 compile wall-clock.
Same agent envelope receives the validated Beast Pack and its recovery/resource controls.

frozen_envelope: model, provider, version, and reasoning effort

hard_gates.acceptance: The run recovers at least one predeclared visual-only fact or action absent from the transcript.
An intentionally ambiguous video segment triggers retained uncertainty-driven reinspection.
The target artifact opens without repair or version conversion.
Required behavior executes in the target application.
The evidence and replay bundle is complete.
No claim exceeds the retained evidence level.
No unauthorized cloud, paid, publication, or destructive action occurs.

promotion_rule: The Beast condition passes every hard gate, visual-only precision and reinspection recall are 1.0, unsupported claims are zero, at least one predeclared correctness or efficiency metric improves over the transcript-only baseline, no acceptance regression occurs, all three condition envelopes and repetitions are matched, and results include every run rather than the best run. The adaptive-frames condition isolates gains from initial visual sampling from gains that require reinspection. Additionally, the beast condition must not lose to curated_skill on the predeclared primary correctness metric; otherwise the report states verbatim: 'curated skills suffice; Beast machinery unjustified at current maturity.'
claim_boundary: This file defines the experiment. It is not evidence that Beast improves performance.
supersedes: beast.loop-benchmark/v1 (file left untouched until v2 approved)

negative_controls.acceptance: Deliberate target version drift after a C3 pass demotes the pack to stale_unproven and the run refuses rather than improvises.
One predeclared ambiguous segment per domain triggers retained reinspection.
A validated but non-matching pack is scoped/refused, never force-applied.

practice_variants.rule: parameter-varied assertions, reported separately; base pass never promoted to generalized on variant failure

arithmetic.tranche_rule: On tranche exhaustion: HALT, publish partial results (labeled partial, every completed run), fresh explicit user gate required to resume. No silent extension.

curated_skill_isolation: Curator seat has no access to C3 packs, typed evidence, or watch bundles; curated skills written before any C3 compile exists; timestamped attestation with curator seat+birth_id in the selection commit; a curator who saw any C3 artifact is burned for that task.
sealed_acceptance: Per-task acceptance criteria, hard-gate parameters, and predeclared visual-only facts are committed at selection time before any C3 compile; selection commit records selector and curator seat+birth_id; post-seal changes void the task.
